newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU unemployment rate steady at 10.8 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: EU unemployment rate steady at 10.8 pct in Sept.

text.p: Unemployment in the European Union was unchanged in September at 10.8 percent, Eurostat, the EU's statistical office said on Tuesday.
This marked the fourth consecutive month with no improvement in the EU's unemployment rate.

Among the 15-nation bloc, a rise in joblessness was seen in France from 12.3 percent in June to 12.5 percent in September. In addition to France, Finland, Ireland, Italy and Spain had unemployment rates above the EU average.
Britain, meanwhile, saw a decline in its jobless rate to 8.1 percent in September from 8.2 percent in the prior month, while Luxembourg continued to have the EU's lowest jobless rate at 3.2 percent.
